create_SiscoreConfig: create a SiscoreConfig builder config for the SI-Score dataset with a specified variant
build_Builder: build a Builder instance for the SI-Score synthetic image dataset
run_Builder_download: run the Builder to download and extract the SI-Score dataset zip from S3
test_Builder_generate_examples: test the Builder's _generate_examples method to yield image records with labels
review_Builder_info: review the Builder's _info method to inspect dataset features and schema
